title: AP Chemistry Independent Foundation Pilot
description: An independently authored 700-question AP Chemistry foundation pilot spanning all nine current units. It tests the blueprint crosswalk, six chemistry science practices, quantitative routines, model analysis, laboratory reasoning, cross-unit reasoning, data interpretation, argumentation, model translation, method design, structured native chapters, and internal QA before any release-ready expansion.
disclaimer: Independent, unofficial AP Chemistry preparation material for internal foundation-pilot development only. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or authored by College Board. This pilot does not provide official scores, score predictions, college-credit predictions, laboratory competency, or a substitute for supervised laboratory work.
contentReview: Seven hundred original source-aligned draft multiple-choice items distributed across all nine current AP Chemistry units, with all six science practices represented, five traceable practice layers, capstone data interpretation and argumentation, model-translation and method-design synthesis, topic remediation routes, quantitative routines, laboratory reasoning, and nine structured native lessons. Independent AP Chemistry subject-expert, laboratory, rights, accessibility, production, field-testing, and psychometric review remain pending.
